title: Approval Decision Request
description: Request body accepted by the development approval endpoints (POST /internal/dev/{research,script,voiceover}-approval/decide) and passed through to resolve_research_approval()/resolve_script_approval()/resolve_voiceover_approval() respectively — one shared shape for all three stages, since the decision contract is identical. `target_chunk_ids` is voiceover-specific (see docs/architecture/voiceover-pipeline.md#targeted-revision) and simply ignored by the research/script resolvers, which don't accept it. See docs/architecture/research-pipeline.md#approval-actions and docs/architecture/script-pipeline.md#approval-actions.

revision_instructions.description: Required (non-empty) when decision is 'revision_requested' — enforced by resolve_research_approval()/resolve_script_approval()/resolve_voiceover_approval().

target_chunk_ids.description: Voiceover approvals only: prior-version voiceover_chunks ids the reviewer wants regenerated. Empty (the default) means the whole track — see docs/architecture/voiceover-pipeline.md#targeted-revision.
